packageRules.description: These release in lockstep with each other (helm.sh/helm/v3 itself pins an exact k8s.io/* minor in its own go.mod) - group them so a bump lands as one reviewable PR instead of several that could land out of sync.
Major Go module bumps (e.g. an import-path-changing rename, or a breaking API redesign) need a manual look before merge, not just a passing build.
